scope: Actual31d to31e original-slope and existing-union discrete reform. Required support, connected/closed main shell, finite normal change, changed-region triangle intersection sweep and named original anchor changes. Historical convex operands are construction history only.
normal_comparison_method: Reconstruct pre-shear positions of final discrete triangles from actual moved before/after records matched to realGLB positions. After-bisect geometry retained. Dot sign is local normal change, not a self-intersection proof.
limits: Historical three operands not used for final exterior or union-volume claims.
No continuum-injectivity argument used as proof of discrete mesh non-intersection.

local_triangle_intersections.scope: Actual finite GLB main-shell triangle intersection check for every pair whose AABBs overlap and at least one triangle differs from31d. Includes all original unchanged triangles as possible partners. No analytic mapping-injectivity argument.
limits: Local changed-region versus entire main-shell sweep only; unchanged/unchanged baseline pairs excluded.
Legal shared vertices/edges ignored only inside0.1mm band; smaller defects are outside stated resolution.
17 independent rocks deliberately intersect main shell as separate objects; their authored contact is not a shell self-intersection.
Numerical triangle test is bounded-resolution evidence, not exact-predicate proof or complete walking test.

old_slope_and_existing_union_actual_anch.scope: Named original31d source vertices matched by actualXYZ to recorded movement, each after position verified in real31eGLB; does not count newly bisected vertices as old source vertices.
